capacity.note: Distribution ZIP and its checksum are excluded exactly as in publish-main-pages. This forecasts the empty optional selector. Actual final staging inventory and uploaded archive must still pass the unchanged CI gates.

sourceBinding: Local generated working-tree build; final committed CI build must be checked separately.
authentication: Fresh locked gate verified. Then a disposable local browser profile uses the same remembered-unlock fixture as access-gate tests. Production HTML, scripts, and verifier are unchanged; no real-password acceptance is claimed.
limits: Chrome on one local host, HTTP localhost secure context; not a public HTTPS deployment test.
Offline installation is activated through the visible host controls using keyboard focus and Enter/Space. Screen-reader behavior and browser application-install prompts are not qualified.
Each package has an isolated browser context. Offline reload/re-entry is tested; browser-process restart and storage eviction are not.
The declared lazy main-game tools extension is outside optional offline packages; its exact unavailable request and user-facing fallback are checked separately.
Advanced remains experimental and unscored; no performance, device, Regional scene, or competition qualification is inferred.
